concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-004 (total wall‑clock time of the physical execution and analysis pipeline) is not linked to any task. No task records, measures, or validates the overall pipeline runtime against the CI time limit, leaving this SC uncovered.

The PhysicalNode data‑model contract (contracts/physical-node.schema.yaml) has no dedicated task that writes or validates per‑node metadata JSON files (e.g., `physical_node_<ip>.json`). Without a task to produce and contract‑validate these artifacts, FR‑002 and the constitution principle VII are not fully satisfied.
